plr_formula.standard: True peak per ITU-R BS.1770-4 Annex 2; integrated loudness per BS.1770-4 with -10 LU relative gating
plr_formula.psr_note: PSR = short-term peak - LUFS-S (per-moment). LRA = 95th - 10th percentile of gated LUFS-S (distribution).

precedence.result: Image follows first arrival; adds width
precedence.use: stab spread 12ms, pad chorus 6-9ms, perc micro-timing ±8-18ms

rules: Clip gain normalises every track to -18.0 dBFS RMS before insert 1
Bus trim compensates downstream (-3 to -12 dB)
clip_gain_law.signal_flow: clip gain -> insert 1..n -> fader (unity) -> pan -> bus trim -> bus inserts -> master trim -> master inserts -> limiter

clip_gain_targets.note: RMS measured over sustained portion, 300ms window. CF = crest factor = peak - RMS. Genre deltas apply to RMS column only; peak ceilings are absolute.

bus_headroom_ladder.note: Only stage permitted to raise level without matching trim.

stem_naming.rules: lowercase, underscore separators only, no spaces/hyphens/parentheses, ASCII only, max 96 chars

export_format_rules.sample_rate: 44.1 kHz music/streaming; 48 kHz broadcast and sync
export_format_rules.dither: TPDF 2 LSB no noise shaping; apply only on final 32-bit float to 24-bit reduction, and only once
export_chain_order: Master bus EQ (±2 dB max, corrective only)
M/S insert per genre table (before limiter)
Render then re-measure (LUFS-I, dBTP, LRA, PLR)

qc_checklist.order_note: Run Tier 1 before Tier 2. A mono-compatibility fault changes the fold-down spectrum; Tier 2 judgements made before Tier 1 passes are made on the wrong signal.

tier_1_mono_compatibility.pass: <=3.0 dB loss on any sustained element
tier_1_mono_compatibility.fail_fix: Sweep bands with mono-maker; usual culprit: widened pad below 300 Hz or chorus with modulation depth crossing zero.

tier_1_mono_compatibility.pass: No timbral change; level within 1.0 dB
tier_1_mono_compatibility.fail_fix: Fix at the track, never with a master-bus mono-maker.

tier_1_mono_compatibility.pass: r >= +0.5 average; transient dips to 0 permitted
tier_1_mono_compatibility.fail_fix: Reduce master width to 110% and re-check; if r stays low, a track is polarity-inverted.

tier_1_mono_compatibility.pass: <=1.0 dB dip in mono at 30-120 Hz
tier_1_mono_compatibility.fail_fix: Enforce H.3 side-channel HPF and re-render.
If inverting makes little difference, check M/S insert is engaged.

tier_2_translation.pass: No element outside the head; no discrete echo
tier_2_translation.fail_fix: Any offset >50 ms heard as discrete repeat; narrow or tempo-sync.

tier_2_translation.pass: All melodic elements audible; kick and snare punch
tier_2_translation.fail_fix: If kick vanishes, add 3-5 kHz click at the track, not master EQ.

tier_2_translation.pass: No masking of vocal or lead after +6 dB @ 80-160 Hz
tier_2_translation.fail_fix: 250-500 Hz too dense; revisit chord track cut.

tier_2_translation.pass: Groove and melody survive at HPF 500 Hz mono
tier_2_translation.fail_fix: Kick needs more 3-4 kHz; bass needs 800 Hz definition partials.
Match loudness before comparing. Compare spectrum balance and PLR.
Mix only works loud: too much information in the frequency extremes.

tier_3_technical_compliance.note: Sample-peak vs true-peak can differ 1-3 dB on a limited master.

tier_3_technical_compliance.pass: No reading above target dBTP after SRC/codec
tier_3_technical_compliance.note: AAC 128 kbit/s can add up to +1.5 dB.
Record both values in the manifest.
Confirm no stray 32-bit float or split-mono files.

tier_3_technical_compliance.pass: 10 ms head fade, 100 ms tail, no DC step
tier_3_technical_compliance.note: DC offset across whole file: <=0.1% of full scale.

tier_3_technical_compliance.pass: All stems share one seed_id; versions match
tier_3_technical_compliance.note: Mismatched seed means stem came from a different generation.

tier_3_technical_compliance.pass: Manifest SHA-256 list matches delivered files
tier_3_technical_compliance.note: Only check that proves delivered bytes are the rendered bytes.
